ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the figure shows an ecological agriculture circulation model, including natural mountain forest area, water source area, biogas digester, ecological pond, and production and living links such as a, b, c. In the figure, it can be seen that arrows related to pollution, such as domestic sewage, waste, and feces, are not directly discharged to the external environment, but enter treatment links such as the biogas digester and ecological pond; the treated biogas, biogas slurry, water, feed, etc. then return to the planting, breeding, or living systems. Then reason: this circulation turns waste into resources and treats sewage, feces, etc., reducing the direct discharge of pollutants, so the main ecological effect in terms of environmental pollution is reducing pollution.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像中的循环结构，找出与环境污染直接相关的箭头：生活污水、废弃物、粪便等并非直接排入环境，而是流向沼气池、生态塘等处理环节，再返回种植、养殖或水源利用系统。结合废物资源化和污水处理的规则，判断该模式使污染物排放量降低，答案写“减少污染”。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中是生态农业循环模式，包含自然山林区、水源区、沼气池、生态池以及 a、b、c 等生产生活环节。图中可见与污染相关的生活污水、废弃物、粪便等箭头不是直接排向外部环境，而是进入沼气池、生态池等处理环节；处理后的沼气、沼液、水、饲料等又返回种植、养殖或生活系统。再推理：这种循环把废弃物资源化，并对污水、粪便等进行处理，减少污染物直接排放，因此在环境污染方面的主要生态效应是减少污染。
